Class RadioUI

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.toolkit.radio.RadioUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
ToolkitUI<Radio>
public class RadioUI extends Object implements ToolkitUI<Radio>
UI strategy implementation for the Radio toolkit.

Binds the specialized RadioRenderer panel to the toolkit instance.
